component.name: Super Productivity
component.summary: To-do list & time tracker for programmers and other digital workers with Jira, Github, and Gitlab integration

description.p: 🚀 Experience the best Open Source ToDo & Time Tracker app and get more done! 🚀
description.h4: 🕐 Personal Task Management with integrated Time Tracking
description.p: => Efficiently manage your tasks and track the time spent on each one. Utilize timeboxing to maintain focus and prevent getting overwhelmed. Effortlessly generate timesheets and work summaries for comprehensive work documentation.
description.h4: 🌍 Seamless Integration with Jira, GitHub, GitLab, OpenProject & More
description.p: => Stay updated with all crucial ticket changes without drowning in a sea of email notifications. Keep everything that matters to you at your fingertips, while effectively filtering out unnecessary information.
description.h4: ✓ Take advantage of a variation productivity helpers
description.p: => Recognizing that everyone's work style and challenges vary, Super Productivity provides a range of customizable productivity tool. These include a Pomodoro timer, a focus mode, self-evaluation tools, and a break reminder.
=> Import your calendar events as tasks whenever needed. Leverage the timeline feature for a swift, at-a-glance overview of your day.
=> The app does NOT collect any data and there are no user accounts or registration required. It's a free and open source and always will be.
